patterns.name: Support the resting hand in the source
patterns.finding: Cafe hand lowered onto clothing but this alone did not fix facial performance. Phone return starts with supported hand, yet mouth movement remained.
patterns.generalization: Single attempts; no causal reference conclusion.

patterns.name: Do not import reference actions wholesale
patterns.finding: Sample02 cafe includes sipping/extended eye closure; speaking clip develops broad smile. Borrow only compatible cues.

patterns.name: Give the free hand a purposeful resting place
patterns.finding: User rejected splayed hand on trouser front. V4 moves hand into outer hip pocket but lifts gaze to camera. Continuing from the last reviewed lowered-head frame (1.9375s) with a short pocket-settle action yields a usable hand-focused segment; mild facial motion persists.
patterns.generalization: Single source and two trials. Pocket gesture is a new hypothesis, not an observed sample02 motion or validated general model behavior.

avoid: Attributing effects to reference alone when model/source/resolution/rate also change
Promoting extracted usable moments as a successful full take
